source_excerpt:
Circular Number : 12/2026
All Additional Secretaries / Chief Financial Officers / Director General (Planning)
Secretary General, Sri Lanka National Commission for UNESCO
All Chief Accountants
All Provincial Directors of Education
All Zonal Directors of Education
Heads of All National College of Education
Delegation of Powers on financial control in terms of Financial Regulation 135 - Year 2026
A schedule of delegation of functions (Annexure 1) is attached for Sec.135 under Expenditure Head 126.
These financial powers shall come into force from 01.01.2026.

gold.issuedBy: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education
gold.targetAudience: Additional Secretaries, CFOs, Chief Accountants, Programme/Project heads, Provincial and Zonal Directors, NCE and teacher training heads
gold.title: MOE Circular 12/2026: FR 135 financial power delegation for 2026

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: Delegates financial control powers under Financial Regulation 135 for programmes and projects under Expenditure Head 126 (General Education Division) for Year 2026.

sections.heading: Key requirements
sections.content: Exercise Authorization, Approval, Certification and Payment powers only within FR, Procurement Guidelines, Establishments Code, and related budget circulars. Use Annexure 1 schedule; acting officers may exercise powers when the delegate is absent.

sections.heading: Legal & circular references
sections.content: Circular No. 12/2026; Financial Regulation 135 (and Sec. 136–139); Budget Circular 09/2025; Establishments Code.

actionItems: Ensure every financial action follows FR and Budget Circular 09/2025.
Assign cheque first signatory to the responsible Chief Accountant/Accountant.
Brief programme and project officers on Authorization/Approval/Certification/Payment roles.
